title: Bind local services to loopback
text: Bind every local web UI or database to 127.0.0.1 and reach it through an SSH tunnel; never open a security-group ingress rule to 0.0.0.0/0 for anything but SSH on port 22.
source: AWS security best practices (VPC security groups)

title: Capacity Blocks are AZ-pinned
text: An EC2 Capacity Block reservation is locked to one Availability Zone; the node group and subnet that consume it must be in that same AZ or the reservation is unusable.
source: EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML user guide

title: Never pin an old EFA installer blindly
text: Never pin an EFA installer or NCCL plugin version without checking upstream for a release in the last six months; record the decision in the commit message.
source: team practice; AWS EFA installer release notes
